scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 60 boards from six live Deity 6p Continents Online Culture-seat games of 2026-11-18/19 with no religion of their own (civvis-20261118T092341Z Pericles, -T122047Z Gorgo, -T181049Z Ramses, civvis-20261119T021649Z Peter, -T053746Z Pedro, -T050804Z Nzinga Mbande): turns (t175 and before) where a Writer's, Artist's or Musician's patron_faith left the gene's reserve in the bank (100, or 700 once Cold War or Conservation is known), at most ten a game, each the run's events.jsonl cut right after that turn's first state row and replayed at that turn. Both arms run one frozen ci-profile civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch head 1b1f02736a (the gene's final code) with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 forced); the on arm adds --with culture-faith-patronizes-the-creators. 60 boards completed in both arms. Orders differ on 18 of them (by run: civvis-20261118T092341Z 2 of 10; civvis-20261118T122047Z 1 of 10; civvis-20261118T181049Z 1 of 10; civvis-20261119T021649Z 4 of 10; civvis-20261119T053746Z 6 of 10; civvis-20261119T050804Z 4 of 10); 0 of those changed something besides Great Person or purchase orders. The on arms journal 22 'culture-faith-patronizes-the-creators:' lines and the off arms 0. Creators patronized with Faith: writer 17, artist 5; their works' slot: open slot 22. Of the 42 unchanged boards, 34 had no open slot of an affordable creator's kind and no compatible slot building within ten Online turns (the gene's slot gate).
